references.observed: Deep compressed whitish-yellow body, pointed snout, curved dark bars over head/body and median fins, tail-base spot, yellow fin margins and rounded transparent caudal.

limitations: Original Chaetodon octofasciatus visual study based on the inspected Robert Fenner photo. Fin rays and fine dentition are simplified; reference photos are not textures and the swimming loop is artist-tuned.
